_description: Chimica e chimico-farmaceutica industria (CNEL B011) level D1, July 2026 regular run, permanent, full time: the first month of the tranche of 1 July 2026.
_notes: TEM D1 = minimo 2,053.03 + IPO 367.23 = 2,420.26 from 1 July 2026 (ipotesi di rinnovo 15 April 2025, page 48, table 'Trattamento Economico Minimo (TEM) mensile alle diverse scadenze', column 01/07/2026, row D1).
D1 has no EAR (categories A and B only) and no EDR before 1 July 2027.
The PDF is a signed scan without text layer: the value was read on the page image and in its OCR text.
Base salary only: allowances and gross depend on facts outside the national table.
